description: Dashboard contract for the historical and IoT Gold datasets.
dashboard_views: Historical monthly climate and price summary with KPI cards, temperature and price trends, precipitation comparison, and detail table
IoT sensor monthly conditions and nutrient summary with KPI cards, condition trends, sensor moisture comparison, nutrient comparison, and detail table

historical-sheet: Line chart: monthly maximum and minimum temperature
Detail table by location, year, and month
iot-sheet: Line chart: monthly temperature and humidity
Bar chart: soil moisture by sensor
Bar chart: average N, P, and K by location
Detail table by sensor, location, year, and month

requires: QuickSight subscription in the AWS account
Athena and Glue permissions for the QuickSight service role
validation: Confirm both datasets can query their Athena tables
Apply YEAR/MM filters and verify partition pruning
Verify the published KPI, chart, and detail-table visuals from the declared dimensions and measures
